The Discharger has since refined its ascorbic acid dosing procedures and plans to significantly reduce its use of chlorinating and dechlorinating chemicals when it completes the plant upgrades, which will include a new UV disinfection system.

The Discharger attributed the March 2019 total coliform exceedance to a disinfectant feed pump failure caused by high back pressure in the pump’s supply line. To reduce the likelihood of a similar event occurring, the Discharger installed pressure relief valves and new feed pumps with a higher pressure capacity.
